sources.entry: PdfDing - PDF manager, viewer and editor offering a seamless user experience on multiple devices. It's designed to be minimal, fast, and easy to set up using Docker. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker/K8S

summary.name: PdfDing
summary.one_liner: PdfDing is a self-hosted PDF manager, viewer, and editor that syncs reading position across devices and is deployed with Docker.
keywords: read pdf on phone and laptop
use_cases: Keep a personal PDF library on your own server
Pick up reading where you left off across devices
Share PDFs or collections with others via link or QR code
Read books in PDF form with self-hosted storage
summary.what_it_does: PdfDing lets you manage, view, and edit PDFs through a web interface. It remembers your last reading position so you can continue on another device. Editing covers adding text, highlighting, and drawing, and you can store signatures for reuse. Organization tools include workspaces, collections, multi-level tagging, starring, and archiving. Collections and PDFs can be shared through a link or QR code with optional access control.
notable: Remembers reading position and syncs it across devices
Supports SSO via OIDC and two-factor auth (TOTP and WebAuthn)
Shareable links and QR codes with optional access control
Listed in awesome-selfhosted under Document Management
caveats: Page does not state an explicit license in its own text; the AGPL-3.0 license comes from the awesome-selfhosted listing
Requires self-hosting on your own infrastructure
